title: Israel orders full West Bank closure after Hebron-area shooting attack wounds five
detail: Israel ordered a full closure of the West Bank after soldiers killed two Palestinians suspected of a shooting attack on Israelis near Hebron that wounded five. Prime Minister Netanyahu cancelled scheduled events.

title: Netanyahu says extensive military operation in West Bank is 'on the way'
detail: Prime Minister Netanyahu said an extensive military operation in the West Bank is 'on the way', hours after Israel ordered a full West Bank closure following the Hebron-area shooting attack.

title: Attack near Hebron kills two Israeli soldiers; Israel announces full West Bank lockdown
detail: An attack near Hebron killed two Israeli soldiers, according to a report aggregated by Google News. Netanyahu vowed a major West Bank military operation and Israel announced a full lockdown of the West Bank. Earlier reports of the same incident cited five wounded; casualty details are still developing.
